title: Automation inventory — derived from the repository
authority_notice: This file is an INVENTORY, not authority. It records behaviour that exists in the repository at the audited commit. Presence in this file authorises nothing, approves nothing, activates nothing and establishes nothing about production. Nothing here may be cited as a grant of autonomy, a certification or a legal position. See BEYU-SCG-04 and BEYU-SCG-08 (R-AUT-01), where authorisation is recorded separately — and where, today, ZERO automations are authorised.

provenance.method: Read from source and schema at the audited commit; behaviour cross-checked against the repository's own test files. No automation was executed against a live provider, a chain or a production database.
provenance.environment: disposable PostgreSQL 16.14, synthetic seed data, no external network calls

classes.A1: Ingest — accept, authenticate, deduplicate and record an inbound event; may refuse.
classes.A2: Observe & compute — read governed data; produce analysis, posture or findings; never mutates.
classes.A3: Record & verify — write a determined platform fact from recorded inputs, with evidence.
classes.A4: Bounded domain write — governed content write of a non-authoritative kind, under per-tool permission.
classes.A5: Trust raising — raise the platform's confidence in a money record, only where enumerated and bounded.
classes.A6: Escalate & notify — raise an escalation, open an exception, name a human.
classes.A7: External execution — sign, submit, broadcast, post, pay or transfer. NONE EXISTS. PROHIBITED without the SC-RM decisions.

entries.name: Noelia scheduler tick
entries.trigger: External caller (no in-process timer); permission ai:schedule.manage; rate limit 10 per 60s; idempotent
side_effects: emits one enterprise-event outbox entry per (schedule, period)
consumes due runs, recording audit evidence
entries.human_binding: Schedules are created and status-changed by permissioned humans; scheduled briefings run as the schedule's recorded owner and re-check authorisation per tool
entries.failure_mode: Failures are recorded; failed count returned; no domain mutation committed
entries.evidence: Audit ledger + enterprise events per run; noelia_schedule_runs

entries.name: Scheduled briefing execution (Noelia)
side_effects: produces analysis output
records audit/event evidence
entries.human_binding: Runs as the schedule's owner principal; every tool call re-checks permission
entries.failure_mode: Governed tool timeout returns an error; nothing is silently retried
entries.evidence: Schedule run record; audit trail

entries.name: Noelia tool invocation surface
entries.trigger: Model-orchestrated tool call under a principal
side_effects: 38 of 43 tools declare sideEffects NONE
5 declare DOMAIN_WRITE: knowledge.ingest, knowledge.replace, knowledge.publish, memory.write, ai.model.route
entries.human_binding: Every tool requires the caller's permission; listing a tool grants nothing
may_not_do: no tool posts to the ledger
entries.failure_mode: Permission refusal or tool error; refusal is recorded
entries.evidence: Audit ledger; tool metadata is enforced by the registry

entries.name: Human approval binding (Noelia control commands)
entries.trigger: A human-control command against a bound payload
side_effects: verifies maker, role, permission, target, payload digest, expected digest, version and expiry
entries.human_binding: The automation exists to enforce that a human approval binds the CURRENT immutable payload; a digest or version mismatch is refused
may_not_do: no approval without a matching digest and version
entries.failure_mode: APPROVAL_DIGEST_MISMATCH and related refusals
entries.evidence: Approval record; audit

entries.name: Payment webhook ingestion
side_effects: records an authenticated transaction with trust RAW→AUTHENTICATED
records refused bodies
opens exceptions
entries.human_binding: None required to record; nothing advances beyond AUTHENTICATED without evidence or a human
may_not_do: no rejection of a genuine money record
entries.failure_mode: Unauthenticated, unparseable or duplicate bodies are recorded and refused; a partial parse records its gaps
entries.evidence: Durable inbox unique on (connection, provider event id); immutable transition trail; audit; governed events

entries.name: Payment settlement ingestion (trust raising)
entries.trigger: Settlement batch or bank statement artefact
side_effects: may raise trust to VERIFIED_PROVIDER / RECONCILED_BANK
marks batches VARIANCE with the arithmetic difference
opens SETTLEMENT_ORPHAN_ITEM exceptions
entries.human_binding: None for the bounded raise; anything beyond the collected artefacts requires human review
may_not_do: no raise past what the artefact supports
entries.failure_mode: Unmatched items become exceptions, never bookings
entries.evidence: Settlement batch rows with variance; exception rows; audit

entries.name: Payment reconciliation pass
entries.entry_point: reconciliation pass over open reconciliation axes
side_effects: records match candidates
may set reconciliation_status RECONCILED at or above the governed confidence floor
entries.human_binding: Confirmation of anything uncertain is a named human act with separation of duties
entries.failure_mode: Disagreement of one unit produces an AMOUNT_MISMATCH exception carrying both numbers
entries.evidence: Match rows with confidence and rule; exception rows

entries.name: Deterministic payment risk rules
side_effects: persists risk signals
marks a transaction non-auto-postable (blocking) and names a human
entries.human_binding: A blocking signal forces human review; the rule decides nothing
may_not_do: no rejection of the money record
no model, no learned score, no probability claim
entries.failure_mode: Signal persisted with its numbers; disposition OPEN or BLOCKED
entries.evidence: Risk signal rows with rule weights; RULE_WEIGHTS version payment-risk-1.0.0
entries.verification: VERIFIED_BY_READING_SOURCE (observed signals: AMOUNT_OVER_POLICY, DAILY_VOLUME_LIMIT, DUPLICATE_AMOUNT_BURST, COUNTERPARTY_VELOCITY, UNMATCHED_HIGH_VALUE; the module header says 'four rules' — documentation drift recorded as an audit observation, not fixed in a documentation-only change set)

entries.name: Contract obligation timing and escalation clock
side_effects: computes due dates and escalation lead times: LOW 14, MEDIUM 10, HIGH 5, CRITICAL 2 days
uses a 30-day post-delivery verification window
entries.human_binding: Verification and closure of an obligation are human acts
may_not_do: PAYMENT obligations remain references with authoritative_owner FINANCE_OS
entries.failure_mode: Deterministic refusal on invalid input
entries.evidence: Obligation rows and events

entries.name: Contract health aggregation
side_effects: computes ON_TRACK / AT_RISK / OVERDUE / SUSPENDED / PAUSED_BY_DISPUTE / DISPUTED
entries.human_binding: Health is derived; it decides nothing
entries.failure_mode: Derived from inputs; absent inputs are reported, not defaulted
entries.evidence: Computed at read time

entries.name: Blockchain anchor verification
side_effects: computes verified true/false with findings
records reorg candidates and commitment mismatches as findings
entries.human_binding: Verification never demotes an anchor; revocation and supersession are separate governed human acts
may_not_do: no silent healing of a block-hash mismatch
entries.failure_mode: Refusal with findings (e.g. insufficient confirmations, unsupported network, commitment mismatch)
entries.evidence: Anchor row with findings, confirmations and status

entries.name: Oracle reading evaluation
side_effects: computes status CURRENT/STALE/EXPIRED/DISPUTED/INVALID/MISSING and usable true/false with findings
entries.human_binding: An unusable reading is a refusal to execute, not a default
may_not_do: no settlement trigger from open data
no adoption of a quarantined deviation
entries.failure_mode: Fail-closed on every axis, including future-dated readings
entries.evidence: Reading rows with findings; source register

entries.name: Registry progression validation (testnet-first)
side_effects: refuses any transition outside the published edge set
enforces that APPROVED_MAINNET is reachable only from VERIFIED_TESTNET
entries.human_binding: The transition itself is requested by a permissioned human
may_not_do: no revival of a deployed or compromised record
entries.failure_mode: INVALID_TRANSITION refusal
entries.evidence: Registry row with status and provenance

entries.name: On-chain execution posture (read-only gate)
side_effects: computes permitted true/false from the governed registers; never stored
entries.human_binding: permitted true is a posture, not a permission; the execution decision belongs to a human
entries.failure_mode: Refusal listing the exact missing gates
entries.evidence: Audit entry for the read; the posture itself is not persisted

entries.name: Blockchain reconciliation run (findings only)
side_effects: records findings: CAP_TABLE_MISMATCH, OWNERSHIP_MISMATCH, VESTING_MISMATCH, TOKEN_BALANCE_MISMATCH, UNAUTHORIZED_TRANSFER, UNKNOWN_HOLDER, STALE_BLOCKCHAIN_STATE
entries.human_binding: Findings require a human decision to act; the run never updates a cap table, contract or obligation
entries.failure_mode: Reports DATA_NOT_AVAILABLE where there is nothing to compare
entries.evidence: blockchain_reconciliation_runs with findings

entries.name: Enterprise event ingestion (cross-OS)
entries.trigger: Authenticated service token from a sector transport
side_effects: appends to the immutable hash-chained enterprise_events ledger
claims an idempotency receipt in the same transaction
entries.human_binding: None for the record; the endpoint grants no authority
may_not_do: no second enterprise event on duplicate delivery
entries.failure_mode: Duplicate delivery increments duplicateCount and returns the original event id
entries.evidence: Enterprise event ledger with hash version 2; audit record

entries.name: Retention eligibility evaluation
side_effects: computes retention expiry from uploaded_at plus policy retention years
reports eligibility as a decision
entries.human_binding: Destruction is a separate governed process requiring human approval; legal holds block deletion regardless of expiry
may_not_do: no workflow status the database cannot represent
entries.failure_mode: Eligibility reported; destruction not performed
entries.evidence: Decision record; policy row

entries.name: Governed execution simulation
side_effects: composes identity → governance → authority → capability → permission → service → execution → audit/event/trace/lineage
classifies every output SIMULATION
entries.human_binding: Explicitly a simulation; a valid synthetic fixture may be SIMULATION_ELIGIBLE, which is not ACTIVATED and not an instruction
entries.failure_mode: Not applicable — never writes
entries.evidence: Simulation output marked SIMULATION

entries.name: Authority verdict evaluation (activation gate)
side_effects: returns a verdict; only ACTIVATED permits execution
entries.human_binding: Activation requires an approved, recorded decision; REFERENCE_DATA never authorises
may_not_do: no activation by seed row, config flag, environment variable or UI state
entries.failure_mode: Fail-closed for unknown, malformed or unverifiable input
entries.evidence: Decision registry rows with provenance

entries.name: Governed idempotency
side_effects: claims an IN_FLIGHT row before the domain write
replays a completed response within TTL
entries.human_binding: An uncertain claim is never auto-reclaimed and is left for a human
may_not_do: no cross-actor replay (scope is tenant + actor + endpoint)
entries.failure_mode: 409 CONFLICT on same key with a different payload
entries.evidence: Idempotency records with payload hash

entries.name: HCM observation
side_effects: reads the single employee master; writes evaluate and refuse
entries.human_binding: Employment lifecycle writes are authority-blocked (REQUIRES_AUTHORITY)
entries.failure_mode: Refusal with reason
entries.evidence: Employee master rows; audit for governed writes

entries.name: Governance escalation recording
side_effects: records escalations against governance calendar events
tracks state transitions
entries.human_binding: Escalation resolution is a human act
entries.failure_mode: Recorded escalation; no silent closure
entries.evidence: governance_escalations rows; audit

entries.name: Operator-invoked scripts
entries.entry_point: scripts/ (seed, payments demo, fixture reset, DR drill, migration, certification)
side_effects: vary by script: bootstrap seed, disposable fixtures, migration ledger, evidence capture
entries.human_binding: An operator runs them deliberately; CI runs migration and gate scripts
may_not_do: never evidence (fixture/demo data is never legal or accounting fact)
no production mutation outside a governed release process
entries.failure_mode: Script exits non-zero; CI gates on it
entries.evidence: Where a script writes evidence, it is captured as an artefact; fixture data is not evidence

human_bindings.name: Contract lifecycle transitions and review gates
human_bindings.why: A gate closes only by a recorded human act carrying the named authority; the software never infers closure

human_bindings.name: Payment confirmation (the only route from uncertain to certain)
human_bindings.why: Separation of duties: whoever prepared it may not confirm it; confirmation does not post and does not adjust amounts

human_bindings.name: Record destruction after retention expiry
human_bindings.why: Eligibility is computed; destruction requires human approval; legal holds block regardless

human_bindings.name: Anchor revocation and supersession
human_bindings.why: Verification never demotes an anchor; the status change is a separate governed act

human_bindings.name: Registry approval transitions and execution decisions
human_bindings.why: Testnet-first and reserved-matter decisions; permitted true is a posture, not a permission

human_bindings.name: Incident pause, upgrade and rollback
human_bindings.why: Pausing, upgrading and revoking are human acts under dual control; automation may not resume a paused package

not_in_inventory: Any signing, broadcasting or transaction-submission behaviour (none exists).
Any live payment-provider adapter (only the mock provider is registered).
Any investment order, redemption or investment-proposal capability (zero hits in src/ and drizzle/).
Any in-process timer, cron expression, worker thread or queue consumer (zero hits in src/).
Any production scheduler configuration (no platform cron configuration exists in the repository).
limitations: Derived by reading source and tests; the automations were not executed against a live provider, chain or production database.
Describes the audited commit only; behaviour may change in later commits, and this inventory must be updated in the same change as any automation change (BEYU-SCG-04 AU-21).
No claim about production configuration, deployed schedules, credentials, integrations or environments is made here.
Presence in this file is not authorisation. Authorisation is recorded in BEYU-SCG-08 R-AUT-01, which today contains ZERO authorised automations.
No claim about legal effect, regulatory compliance or security posture is made here, and none may be inferred.
